findings.summary: The same labels repeat in every row ('מהחיסכון', 'מההפקדות', 'מניות', 'מט"ח', '3 שנים / 5 שנים'), so the reader keeps re-reading them to find the one number that differs.
The company header row scrolls away while the table header stays at the top, so the reader loses track of which company's tracks they are looking at.
Many rows show 'פחות מ־3 שנים' where the return should be, so the reader can't compare returns and doesn't know what it means.
Fees appear only as small percentages with nothing in shekels, so the gap between 0.56% and 0.73% looks trivial.
There is no starting point or recommendation among 143 tracks that look alike, and the reader is close to giving up for today.
The ring colours only make sense when matched to tiny dots next to the numbers, and the reader isn't sure they read the exposure rings correctly.
The filter chips under 'במה הכסף מושקע' use unexplained jargon ('משולב סחיר', 'אג"ח ממשלתי', 'עוקב מדדים - גמיש').
The underlined numbers look like links, though the reader didn't plan to tap them.
